purpose: Specify the post-lock scoring inputs, matching, denominators, and summaries before the primary two-pass wave-2 run; a separate six-source JATS-only feasibility pilot is disclosed below and excluded.

pre_lock_format_pilot_deviation.procedure: Before the primary raw-output lock, a separate worker screened six opaque JATS captures once after rendering them to Markdown with the frozen renderer and CLI.
pre_lock_format_pilot_deviation.format_comparison: No same-version PDF captures were available, so no JATS-versus-PDF comparison was performed.
pre_lock_format_pilot_deviation.implication: The six papers remain in the primary run but had prior report exposure to the format-evaluation worker; blinding is within-workflow, not independent.

output_lock.path: A tracked, committed validation/paper-audit-wave-2/.../LOCK.json file whose committed bytes equal its working-tree bytes.

required_fields.source_manifest_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of exact committed manifest bytes
required_fields.runner_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of committed tools/run_paper_audit_wave_2_blind.py bytes

papers.paper_id: opaque unique identifier; no role, label, source title, or outcome field

raw_outputs.path: repository-relative path to a persisted output; no absolute paths, dot segments, or symlinks
raw_outputs.sha256: lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of exact file bytes
raw_outputs.paper_id: required for report_json, report_html, and run_metadata; absent for source_metadata
raw_outputs.run_id: run-1 | run-2 for report_json, report_html, and run_metadata; absent for source_metadata

requirements: The lock and every listed raw output must be tracked, committed, and byte-identical to the current HEAD version.

The source manifest and wave-2 runner are committed and their exact bytes match source_manifest_sha256 and runner_sha256. Exactly one source_metadata record appears in raw_outputs, and it is that source manifest.
Every persisted report, HTML report, and run/source metadata file must have exactly one raw_outputs entry and its SHA-256 is verified before ground truth or adjudication is opened.
Each opaque paper_id has exactly one report_json and one report_html for each of run-1 and run-2.
The lock paper_id set must exactly equal both the committed source-only manifest and ground-truth paper_id sets.

The committed source-only manifest has only top-level renderer and papers fields. Each papers[] entry has only paper_id and source; source has exactly source_kind, snapshot_name, source_url, retrieved_at, sha256, source_version, and license. Its paper_id set matches the lock, and each run_metadata source.source_sha256 agrees with source.sha256.

Each (paper_id, run_id) has one run_metadata entry with exactly the frozen runner's top-level fields: metadata_version, paper_id, run_id, source, frozen_baseline, execution_environment, runtime_seconds, decision, extraction_status, extraction_warnings, checks_attempted, unsupported_checks, candidate_count, candidate_types, candidate_type_counts, file_sha256, and repeatability. source has exactly source_kind, source_sha256, staged_input_sha256, source_version_token, renderer_version, renderer_sha256; frozen_baseline has exactly commit, tree_sha, package_version, paper_audit_schema_version. source_kind and source_sha256 agree with the source-only manifest. The frozen baseline pins must equal the preregistered commit/tree; repeated-run source and baseline pins must agree; report hashes must equal their raw_outputs entries.

Each report has paper_audit_version=0.2 and report.source.identifier, report.source.version, and report.source.sha256 equal paper_id, source.source_version_token, and source.staged_input_sha256 from its matching run_metadata.

papers.paper_id: same opaque identifier as the output lock

targets.candidate_type: exact value required in report candidate type

required_anchors.quote: case-sensitive source quote; whitespace runs alone are normalized

requirements: Every positive paper has at least one issue; negative papers have no positive_issues entry.

Eligible issues have one or more targets; unsupported_by_frozen_screens issues may have an empty targets array and always count as not rediscovered when targetless. Every declared target has one or more operands and required_anchors.
An issue is rediscovered only when every expected target item is assigned to a distinct adjudicated candidate item that matches its type, every declared operand, and every required anchor.

required_fields.lock_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact committed LOCK.json bytes; binds adjudication to the locked run

candidate_items.candidate_id: id from the run-1 report candidate_anomalies item
candidate_items.target_id: required only for matches_known_issue; target from ground_truth

scope_notes.scope_note_id: id from the run-1 report possible_scope_differences item

requirements: Every run-1 candidate item and every run-1 scope note has exactly one adjudication row; missing, duplicate, or extra rows fail scoring.
A matches_known_issue decision must name a same-paper target and the candidate must match that target under the conservative matcher.

Candidates without a supported correction-target mapping may be adjudicated false_candidate, unresolved, or legitimate_nonbenchmark_discrepancy. Absence of a known correction is not itself evidence that a candidate is false.
Adjudication must name the exact output lock hash, so it cannot silently be reused for another locked run.
Only false_candidate is counted as reviewer-confirmed false. unresolved and legitimate_nonbenchmark_discrepancy remain in the precision denominator but are not false candidates.

candidate_to_target: Candidate type must equal candidate_type exactly.
Each declared operand field must exist on the candidate and its JSON value must equal the expected value exactly; no numeric, case, or punctuation coercion is done.

Every required anchor must match a distinct candidate source_anchors entry. Quotes are case-sensitive and compared after collapsing runs of whitespace to one ASCII space and trimming. If a required anchor supplies section or page_number, that field must also equal exactly.
Candidate adjudication must explicitly assign a matching candidate to a target. Each target can be assigned to at most one candidate item.
matching.issue_rediscovery: An issue is rediscovered if and only if each target in that issue has one distinct candidate item adjudicated matches_known_issue and matching that target.
matching.candidate_precision: Numerator is run-1 candidate items adjudicated matches_known_issue and passing the target matcher. Denominator is all run-1 candidate items across all papers, including false_candidate, unresolved, and legitimate_nonbenchmark_discrepancy items; each item must be adjudicated.

positive_issue_rediscovery_all.denominator: all positive issues, including unsupported_by_frozen_screens issues

candidate_precision.numerator: adjudicated matches_known_issue candidate items with an exact target match

negative_papers_with_candidates.numerator: negative papers with one or more run-1 candidates

false_candidates_per_negative_paper.numerator: run-1 negative-paper candidates adjudicated false_candidate by a reviewer

metrics.candidate_adjudication: Count matches_known_issue, false_candidate, unresolved, and legitimate_nonbenchmark_discrepancy separately. Report reviewer-confirmed false candidates per negative paper. Report unresolved count and fraction of all candidate items, plus unresolved negative-candidate count and fraction of negative-paper candidate items.

scope_notes.notes_per_paper: scope note count / all papers; a count rate, not a binomial proportion
scope_notes.papers_with_scope_notes: papers with at least one scope note / all papers
scope_notes.classifications: counts and proportions of all scope notes classified useful, benign, misleading, or false

unsupported_positive_issues.rate: unsupported positive issues / all positive issues

metrics.reported_unsupported_checks: Count report unsupported_checks strings on run-1; summarize counts only, not text.

extraction.status_counts: Counts by exact extraction.status across one primary report per paper.
extraction.scan_incomplete: Report discovery.scan_complete=false separately; it may overlap an extraction outcome bucket.

metrics.repeatability: For each paper compare exact bytes for run-1 versus run-2 report.json and report.html; report JSON, HTML, and joint identical-paper counts and raw fractions.
metrics.confidence_interval_policy: Report raw numerator and denominator for every fraction. Use Wilson 95% intervals only for the four named binomial metrics; if a denominator is zero, estimate and interval are null. Candidate-precision Wilson intervals use candidate items as Bernoulli units and may understate uncertainty when items cluster within papers; negative-paper candidate rate is calculated at paper level. No aggregate accuracy or arbitrary-paper correctness metric is produced.

cli.output: JSON summary to stdout unless --output names a destination file.
cli.execution_gate: Run only after LOCK.json is committed and the authorized evaluator confirms that commit.
